invariants.name: Every non-public request has a verified owner
invariants.breaks: A forged, tampered, or missing identity reaches app state.
invariants.why: All five apps gate on Cloudflare identity: Access JWT or Sign in with Cloudflare.
invariants.fix: Verify an Access JWT or an HMAC-signed session before any app route; refuse with 401.
tests: forged and tampered sessions are refused
an Access header without configured Access is refused

invariants.name: State lives in a Durable Object keyed by that owner
invariants.breaks: One owner reads another owner state, or a header or query picks the owner.
invariants.why: Thread/Hark/UserAgent/AgentDO/Body: one durable home per owner or thread, with SQLite.
invariants.fix: Derive the Durable Object name from the verified owner only; ignore owner hints in headers and query.
tests: state survives and is keyed by owner
one owner cannot read another owner

invariants.name: The payer is explicit, and a user payer never falls back to host inference
invariants.breaks: A signed-in user call is billed to the host without the operator choosing it.
invariants.why: coil/hark/skin route model calls to the user account; my-ax/chat-ax use host AI. The rule is: say which, never mix silently.
invariants.fix: Declare the payer in config; when the payer is user and no grant exists, fail instead of calling env.AI.
tests: user payer with no grant fails instead of using host inference
user payer with a grant routes to the user account

invariants.name: Secrets and grant tokens never reach the browser or a log
invariants.breaks: A token appears in any response or log line.
invariants.why: Tokens live in DO storage; responses and logs are redacted.
invariants.fix: Keep tokens in Durable Object storage; never echo them; redact before logging.
tests: the grant token never appears in any response

invariants.name: Writes must come from the app origin
invariants.breaks: A signed-in cookie lets another site write.
invariants.why: A signed-in cookie must not let another site write.
invariants.fix: Refuse non-GET requests whose Origin header is not the app origin.

invariants.name: Agent-written code runs in an isolate with no ambient network or secrets
invariants.breaks: Agent code reaches the network or a binding it was not given.
invariants.why: coil/hark/skin load agent code with Worker Loader and globalOutbound: null; containers hold the computer.
invariants.fix: Load agent code with Worker Loader and globalOutbound: null; pass only the bindings it needs.

invariants.name: A run is visible, truthful, and stoppable
invariants.breaks: A run shows running forever after eviction, or a late result overwrites a stop.
invariants.why: Every app shows a running turn and lets the owner stop it; a stop must stick.
invariants.fix: Store run status; mark running rows interrupted on start; update to a final status only WHERE status = running.
tests: a run is visible, finishes truthfully, and a stop sticks

invariants.name: Changes the agent makes are versioned, gated, and append-only
invariants.breaks: A failing change goes live, or rollback rewrites history.
invariants.why: skin generations, coil snapshot pairs, my-ax artifacts: the agent changes things, so changes need history and a gate.
invariants.fix: Store versions in an append-only table; gate before live; rollback inserts a new row.
tests: a broken version is rejected and never goes live
rollback appends; history is never rewritten

invariants.name: Public pages are served before the gate; nothing else is
invariants.breaks: An API route answers without identity, or a public page needs sign-in.
invariants.why: Landing, /docs, /llms.txt, /robots.txt are public by design (repo shape v2); every other route is not.
invariants.fix: Keep one PUBLIC set served before the identity check; everything else goes through it.
